scope: Question-only endpoint designs for independent observed-data workflow adaptations; no benchmark answers, fixtures or exact-answer reproduction. Nearby broad question IDs are navigation, not equivalence claims.
design_principles: One coherent observed-data task per recipe by default. These refine the 147 broad questions; do not add design counts across planning levels.

Pin each independent study accession, release, license, checksum, native file formats, biological dimensions and every subset transformation. Source paper/accession identifiers listed here are exclusions, not proposed training sources.
Freeze complete schemas, numerical tolerances, package versions and offline annotation snapshots before implementation. Proposed artifact columns are not complete validated schemas.
Run the actual package reference plus independent input/artifact invariants. Negative controls corrupt outputs against fixed observations; no assumption that random labels must change significance.

Question inspection cannot recover omitted source methods. Ambiguous or scientifically invalid source formulations remain explicit gaps; a corrected authored task is a method adaptation, not exact endpoint equivalence.

All designs still need independent input selection, native oracle/verifier runs, incorrect-output checks and measured offline runtime at most 30 minutes. No release readiness or coverage forecast is implied.

method_references.use: Unnormalized counts or valid quantified-count import; full-rank model and shrinkage/contrast semantics.
Equivalence requires bounds and an equivalence test; nonsignificant difference is not an equivalence result.
Native metric entry points; pinned implementation details still require per-metric reconciliation.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which disease-associated expression effects and GO processes persist after explicit count filtering, effect shrinkage and semantic term reduction?
designs.input_design: Independent replicated case/control raw RNA counts with documented covariates, GTF/GFF3 gene identifiers and pinned GO/gene annotations.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: samples.tsv: sample, condition, covariates, inclusion
results.tsv: gene, base_mean, raw_lfc, shrunken_lfc, p, q, testable
go.tsv: term, gene_universe, overlap, p, q, representative_term
members.tsv: term, gene, direction, eligibility
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Full-rank design, reference condition, apeglm coefficient, raw versus adjusted significance masks per endpoint, tested background versus all annotated genes, GO version, simplify semantic measure/cutoff/representative rule, ties and rounding.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Run native DESeq2/clusterProfiler oracle and independently check contrast direction, complete gene/term universes, memberships and multiplicity. Mutate a contrast sign, universe size or simplified representative and require failure.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need independent raw counts and sufficiently replicated condition design; annotation snapshot must be license-compatible offline and complete enough for semantic reduction; runtime unmeasured.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: The source mixes p and padj criteria and calls a term result a threshold. Keep each explicit mask distinct. Specific genes/terms may be absent or nonsignificant in independent observations; do not select data to force their published answer.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: How do treatment, exposure and baseline comorbidity relate to ordered disease severity, including prespecified interaction and subgroup estimates?
designs.input_design: Independent participant-level observed ordered severity, treatment/exposure metadata and baseline comorbidity, including treatment design provenance.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: patients.tsv: id, severity, treatment, exposure, history, inclusion
models.tsv: model, term, coefficient, se, odds_ratio, p, threshold
contingencies.tsv: subgroup, treatment, severity, count
subgroup_tests.tsv: subgroup, statistic, df, p, assumptions
assumptions.tsv: model, diagnostic, statistic, p, criterion, status, fallback_used
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Ordered category levels, proportional-odds model convention, baseline categories, interaction centering, complete-case policy, all subgroup definitions, chi-square continuity correction and sparse-cell eligibility, adjusted multiplicity. Prespecify a proportional-odds diagnostic and threshold, along with an assumption-failed output or a declared partial-proportional/multinomial sensitivity model. A fallback changes the estimand and must not be reported as the original common odds ratio.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Native ordered-logit fit plus independent design, log-likelihood, exp(coefficient) and contingency arithmetic. Reject wrong severity ordering, a pooled subgroup or an odds reduction with reversed reference. Recompute the prespecified assumption check and reject a common-odds interpretation when the contract requires an assumption-failed status.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need independent cohort with both outcome levels and enough observations in all covariate cells; complete or quasi-separation and unsupported proportional odds require explicit statuses.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: An interaction-model main effect applies at reference/zero covariates; do not describe it as a universal treatment effect. Frozen subgroup comparisons describe association unless randomization supports a defined causal estimand.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: How do evolutionary branch summaries vary across independent observed orthologs in two clades, and which summaries depend on rooting or tip anomalies?
designs.input_design: Observed ortholog loci and provenance-linked Newick trees with taxon manifests, branch units and explicit rooting; retain one biological orthogroup per replicate.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: trees.tsv: locus, clade, rooted, n_tips, total_length, treeness, rate, dvmc
tips.tsv: locus, clade, tip, long_branch_score
distances.tsv: locus, clade, tip_a, tip_b, patristic_distance
comparisons.tsv: metric, group, n, median, mean, variance, quantile, u, p
paired.tsv: locus, metric, clade_a, clade_b, difference, ratio
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Metric formulas, processing, aggregation order, group orientation, missingness, native-versus-corrected LB and rounding are specified in ortholog_signal_contract. Validate package execution and proposed numerical bounds before release.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Run native metrics and independently reconstruct branch sums, path distances and grouped summaries. Reject duplicate orthogroup replicates, a wrong root or a corrupted distance. Document native implementation discrepancies instead of silently substituting another formula.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Thirty distinct candidate OGs with matched alignments/trees are inventoried; native tree metrics passed a scoped audit. Exact mirror rights and benchmark lineage, native alignment execution and complete Harbor runtime remain unresolved.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: Two animal clades replace the original animal/fungal contrast. The shared contract states authored rooting, precision, sample-SD and saturation conventions where source questions are underspecified. Source named loci become outcome-independent manifest IDs. No exact benchmark-answer or full-coverage claim.

endpoint_contracts.operation: median(B[locus] / A[locus] over matched eligible loci)

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: How do informative sites, compositional variability and saturation relate to tree signal across independently observed loci and clades?
designs.input_design: Matched aligned FASTA and Newick per observed orthogroup/clade, native gap/missing/ambiguity symbols and provenance-linked taxon sets.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: alignments.tsv: locus, clade, taxa, columns, gaps, informative_sites, informative_fraction, rcv, saturation
signal.tsv: locus, clade, treeness, rcv, ratio, eligible
comparisons.tsv: metric, group, n, median, quantile, u, p
pairs.tsv: locus, metric, clade_difference
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Metric formulas, processing, aggregation order, group orientation, missingness, native-versus-corrected LB and rounding are specified in ortholog_signal_contract. Validate package execution and proposed numerical bounds before release.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Native PhyKIT plus independent informative-site counts, residue frequencies, gap denominators and summaries. Reject a counted ambiguity, omitted low-signal locus or mismatched locus pair.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Thirty distinct candidate OGs with matched alignments/trees are inventoried; native tree metrics passed a scoped audit. Exact mirror rights and benchmark lineage, native alignment execution and complete Harbor runtime remain unresolved.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: Two animal clades replace the original animal/fungal contrast. The shared contract states authored rooting, precision, sample-SD and saturation conventions where source questions are underspecified. Source named loci become outcome-independent manifest IDs. No exact benchmark-answer or full-coverage claim.

endpoint_contracts.operation: max(values over both clades where gap_percent > 70)
median(B[locus] - A[locus] over matched eligible loci)

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which gene and pathway changes are shared by single and combined perturbations across observed growth environments?
designs.input_design: Independent replicated raw microbial counts for control, two single perturbations and their combination across at least two documented media, plus gene/KEGG annotations.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: samples.tsv: sample, replicate, perturbation, medium
model.tsv: sample, coefficient, design_value
genes.tsv: gene, contrast, raw_dispersion, fitted_dispersion, effect, p, q, call
sets.tsv: gene, contrast_membership, exclusive_call
pathways.tsv: contrast, direction, pathway, eligible, overlap, p, q
pathway_members.tsv: pathway, gene, contrast
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Full-rank replicate/perturbation/media design, interaction estimands, raw gene-wise dispersion versus shrunk estimate, each threshold mask, set union/intersection denominator, ORA directional semantics, fixed KEGG release and tested background.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Native DESeq2/reference enrichment plus independent contrast/set/ORA checks. Reject shrunk dispersions labeled raw, a mixed direction intersection or a pathway absent from the tested universe.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Finding an independent complete factorial observed experiment with biological replication is the gating requirement; separate tasks if one coherent fit exceeds30min.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: Pathways do not themselves have a DESeq2 log fold change; interpret direction through separately defined up/down gene sets. Latest KEGG in the source becomes a declared immutable snapshot.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: How do low-allele-fraction exonic variants and their annotation classes differ across observed patient groups after consistent sample and variant filtering?
designs.input_design: Independent VCF/BCF calls with allele depths, sample metadata, GFF3/GTF reference annotations and a frozen clinical classification snapshot.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: samples.tsv: sample, patient, group, age, sex, eligible
variants.vcf: normalized allele-specific calls
events.tsv: sample, variant, gene, vaf, consequence, classification, qualifying
counts.tsv: sample, count, includes_zero
cohorts.tsv: group, consequence, numerator, denominator, median, iqr
comparisons.tsv: group, contrast, statistic, p, q
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Genome build, allele depth denominator, multiallelic splitting, transcript consequence precedence, gene set, strict versus inclusive VAF cutoffs, unique variant versus sample-variant count, zero-event samples, age/group ties and group comparison method.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Native normalization/consequence reference plus independent allele-depth, sample union, class denominator and quantile checks. Reject reference calls, double-counted alleles or dropped zero-variant samples.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need independently licensed calls with observed depth and clinically interpretable metadata; sensitive or unavailable patient metadata cannot be invented.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: VAF<0.3 is an operational source rule, not proof of somatic origin. Annotation benignity and CHIP membership are separate; disease-group labels from the benchmark are not copied to an unrelated cohort.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which gene expression levels correlate with measured cell-line dependency after identifier and assay eligibility checks?
designs.input_design: Independent matched observed cell-line RNA abundance and CRISPR dependency scores, with lineage metadata and versioned gene crosswalk.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: matched.tsv: cell_line, gene, expression, dependency, eligible
associations.tsv: gene, n, rho, p, q, direction
distribution.tsv: scale, n, skewness, definition
summary.tsv: eligible_genes, strong_positive, significant, denominator
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: log2(TPM+1) transform, complete-pair policy, minimum lines, Spearman tie handling, constant genes, tested-gene multiplicity universe and skewness estimator/interpretation cutoffs.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Independent joins/ranks/correlations and native statistics reference; reject mismatched cell-line IDs, wrong dependency score orientation or multiplicity over selected hits only.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need release with compatible lines and independent study lineage; whole-matrix runtime/footprint must be bounded without selecting on correlation.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: Correlated expression and dependency are associations, not causal essentiality proof. The source does not define qualitative skewness cutoffs.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: How do observed single-strain and mixed-culture colony area and circularity differ from a declared reference?
designs.input_design: Independent real colony images or documented measured morphometry with units, plate/batch, biological replicate and mixture identity.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: colonies.tsv: colony, plate, replicate, group, area, circularity, qc
summaries.tsv: group, n, mean_area, mean_circularity, sem
contrasts.tsv: endpoint, group, reference, effect, interval, dunnett_p
similarity.tsv: mixture, scaled_distance, rank
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Image segmentation if required, pixel-to-physical conversion, independent replicate unit, pooled variance or mixed/block design, Dunnett multiplicity, SEM denominator and bivariate similarity metric.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Native morphometry/statistics reference and independent moments/contrast checks; reject pixel areas labeled mm2, pseudoreplicated colonies or a wrong reference mean.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need observed biological replicates and known imaging scale; if raw images are used, segmentation choices and runtime must be pinned.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: Failure to reject Dunnett difference does not establish equivalence (bix-41-q1). Report non-rejection honestly; a true equivalence endpoint needs prespecified margins and a separate appropriate test, so exact formulation coverage stays unresolved.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which mixture proportion maximizes the fitted observed colony response, and how uncertain is that estimate across prespecified curve models?
designs.input_design: Independent mixture-series morphometry with measured fractions, replicate structure, area units and observed frequency range.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: observations.tsv: replicate, fraction, area, eligible
models.tsv: model, term, coefficient, se, r2, f, p, selection_score
predictions.tsv: model, fraction, mean, lower, upper
optima.tsv: model, fraction, area, lower, upper, boundary
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Natural spline df=4 knot/boundary rules, quadratic/cubic parametrization, model-selection rule, bounded continuous optimization versus fixed grid, mean CI versus prediction interval, uncertainty at selected optimum and replicate dependence.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Native curve fits plus independent design/prediction/residual checks and bounded extremum verification. Reject an out-of-range optimum, inverted mixture ratio or wrong unit conversion.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need observed full-range mixture experiment with enough distinct fractions and replication; selected-optimum interval coverage requires a specified procedure.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: Distinguish fraction of total from strain-to-strain ratio; df=4 spline p-value and best-model maximum are distinct endpoints.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: What effect size and interaction estimates follow from observed neuronal counts, and what nominal sample size follows from an explicitly assumed future design?
designs.input_design: Independent measured neuronal counts with condition, hemisphere, sex and animal IDs, preserving within-animal pairing when documented.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: counts.tsv: animal, hemisphere, sex, condition, count
effects.tsv: contrast, mean_difference, pooled_sd, cohens_d
tests.tsv: group, shapiro_w, p; term, anova_f, df, p
power.tsv: design, effect_size, alpha, target_power, continuous_n, rounded_n
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Independent versus paired animals, pooled-SD definition, ANOVA sums of squares/interaction and repeated-measures handling, Shapiro missingness, two-sided noncentral-t power and upward rounding.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Native effect/test/power reference plus independent means/SD and achieved-power checks; reject paired rows treated as new independent animals or rounding down sample size.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need suitable observed count study with documented hierarchy; two-sample prospective calculation must be labeled hypothetical if source observations are paired.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: Post-hoc observed-effect power is a conditional design calculation, not evidence that the study was adequately powered; do not interpret a nonsignificant normality test as proof of normality.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: How does measured expression relate to consistently defined gene length across sorted immune cell types?
designs.input_design: Independent sorted-cell RNA count/abundance data with biological replicates and matching GTF gene/exon annotations.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: genes.tsv: gene, biotype, length, length_definition
means.tsv: gene, cell_type, n_samples, mean_expression
correlations.tsv: cell_type, n_genes, pearson_r, p, eligibility
ranking.tsv: cell_type, abs_r, rank
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Gene span versus union-exonic/transcript length, expression scale, protein-coding universe, sample averaging versus pooling, zero/constant features, source q6 cell-type aggregation and correlation uncertainty unit.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Native annotation parsing plus independent interval-length/mean/Pearson checks; reject transcript length substituted for declared gene length or raw r sorted instead of abs(r).
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need independent observed sorted-cell data and matching release annotations; expression-length association depends strongly on normalization.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: An across-gene association may reflect count/length normalization and does not alone establish biological regulation. Source pooled q6 needs a declared aggregation rule.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which gene and pathway changes distinguish single and combination perturbations relative to a shared observed vehicle condition?
designs.input_design: Independent replicated raw RNA counts across vehicle, single treatment and combination, with fixed GO and Reactome gene-set snapshots.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: genes.tsv: contrast, gene, effect, base_mean, p, q, up, down
enrichment.tsv: contrast, direction, library, term, overlap, odds_ratio, p, q
members.tsv: contrast, term, gene, selected
summaries.tsv: contrast, term, numerator, denominator, rank
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Each source-specific raw/adjusted-p and fold-change mask, signed direction, ORA universe, GO/Reactome release, GSEApy odds-ratio definition and zero-cell correction, top-term tie rules and fraction denominator.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Native DESeq2/GSEApy reference plus independent set counts, hypergeometric/multiplicity and pathway rankings; reject selected-only universes, wrong denominator or reversed contrast.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need independent observed complete perturbation panel and licensed offline annotation snapshots; combination-versus-vehicle alone does not identify synergy.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: Source mechanistic prose becomes an evidence-linked declared pathway output; enrichment supports association. Named pathways may be absent and must not be forced to match.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which expression-defined patient groups are stable under prespecified resampling and what independent pathway annotations characterize them?
designs.input_design: Independent observed patient-by-gene expression with documented scale, no outcome-derived group labels and a pinned Reactome mapping.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: pca.tsv: component, variance, explained_fraction
resamples.tsv: iteration, sample, train_or_test, cluster, aligned_cluster, predicted_cluster
consensus.tsv: sample_a, sample_b, opportunities, agreements
membership.tsv: sample, group, stability
enrichment.tsv: group, term, genes, p, q
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: log10(x+1) compatibility with input scale, PCA centering/scaling, three-cluster hierarchical distance/linkage, 50 resampling seeds, 70/30 split policy, logistic label prediction, label alignment, consistent-sample rule and cluster-specific-gene definition.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Native clustering/classifier/enrichment reference plus split disjointness, consensus denominators, variance and membership checks. Reject arbitrary label-number comparisons, test IDs in fit rows or a missing resample.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need enough observed patients and independent biological groups; 50 fits plus enrichment must be measured under 30 minutes.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: Source does not fully define bootstrap versus train/test sampling or consensus consistency. Freeze a scientifically coherent authored protocol before assigning workflow equivalence.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which observed tissue, time and response contrasts share expression changes after preserving subject structure and a valid count model?
designs.input_design: Independent replicated raw counts with subject, tissue, time and independently measured response metadata; multiple tissue samples per subject when available.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: samples.tsv: sample, subject, tissue, time, response, inclusion
design.tsv: sample, term, value
genes.tsv: gene, contrast, base_mean, effect, p, q
overlaps.tsv: gene, contrast_membership
proportions.tsv: contrast, eligible, de, fraction, wilson_lower, wilson_upper
tests.tsv: estimand, statistic, p, assumptions
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Raw counts or proper quantified-count import, paired versus unpaired design, each threshold mask, independent filtering and tested-gene denominator, Wilson definition, optional binomial null and gene-dependence limitation; define Category ANOVA response/replicate unit.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Native DESeq2 plus independent contrast/set/Wilson arithmetic; reject normalized abundances disguised as integer read counts, missing subject pairing or an incorrect overlap universe.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need independent raw-count longitudinal/multi-tissue dataset with documented response and estimable model; source ANOVA and binomial endpoints need methodological clarification.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: Source bix-3-q1 suggests scaling normalized values into pseudocounts: do not reproduce this. Counts are needed for the DESeq2 sampling model. Genes are dependent, so a binomial DE fraction test cannot by itself establish negligible biological effect.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: How do prespecified multiple-testing procedures change observed miRNA differential-expression calls?
designs.input_design: Independent observed miRNA assay abundances with documented measurement scale, patient/control labels and biological replication.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: features.tsv: mirna, transformed_values, eligibility

calls.tsv: mirna, raw_call, bh_call, by_call, bonferroni_call
summary.tsv: method, numerator, denominator, fraction, ratio
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: log2 offset/zero policy, paired or independent t-test, equal-variance versus Welch, missingness, p<=0.05, complete tested universe, undefined ratio when zero discoveries.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Native t-tests/corrections and independent rank/multiplicity arithmetic; reject corrections over significant features only or wrong zero-denominator rendering.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need independent biologically replicated miRNA measurements appropriate to log-scale testing.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: The source repeats pre-correction endpoints; share one full test table and retain both target IDs without claiming two independent workflows.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which sex-associated expression effects differ across observed cell populations and gene biotypes under prespecified shrinkage and selection?
designs.input_design: Independent donor-replicated sorted-cell counts with sex metadata, cell identity and pinned gene-biotype annotations.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: samples.tsv: donor, cell_type, sex, inclusion
effects.tsv: gene, cell_type, biotype, raw_effect, shrunk_effect, base_mean, p, q
sets.tsv: gene, selected_rule, eligible
comparisons.tsv: biotype_or_cell_group, n, mean_effect, t, df, p
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Estimate sex effects between independent donors within each cell type, with documented batch/covariates and at least biological replication per sex. For joint cell-type analysis use a justified donor random effect or an explicitly estimable sex-by-cell-type interaction; do not include donor fixed intercepts alongside a time-invariant sex main effect. Freeze shrinkage type/coefficient, separate p and padj masks, absolute-effect cutoffs, CD4/CD8 grouping, Welch/equal-variance choices and gene-dependence interpretation.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Native count/shrinkage reference plus gene-biotype join, selection and descriptive Welch arithmetic; reject raw effects mislabeled shrunken or wrong biotype universe. Verify design rank and the estimability of each requested contrast; reject a sex main effect absorbed by donor fixed effects.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need independent observed donors in each sex/cell-type group and known batch structure; gene-level post-selection comparisons do not provide independent biological replication.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: Source across-gene t-tests are descriptive method adaptations with selection/dependence caveats; specific source genes become declared independent-study targets.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which cell populations show the broadest donor-replicated treatment expression response, including prespecified genes?
designs.input_design: Independent observed H5AD or MTX counts with donor, cell type, treatment and time metadata.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: cells.tsv: cell, donor, type, qc
pseudobulk.tsv: donor, type, gene, count
results.tsv: type, gene, effect, p, q, testable
summary.tsv: type, eligible_genes, significant_genes, target_gene_status
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Minimum cells/donors, paired treatment design, count filter, gene universe per type, BH within versus across types, target-gene absence and tie handling.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Native pseudobulk DE reference and independent aggregation/denominators; reject cell-level pseudoreplication or interpreting absent genes as nonsignificant measured genes.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need independent observed treatment/control donors with adequate counts per cell type; one treated individual cannot support donor-level treatment inference.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: Broad source question leaves cell-level testing unspecified; scientifically valid donor-level adaptation must state its method and mapping limit.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: How do observed miRNA profiles and their fold-change distributions differ across sorted immune cell populations?
designs.input_design: Independent donor-linked miRNA abundance by sorted cell type and assay metadata; exclude pooled PBMC according to a frozen rule.

tests.tsv: endpoint, factor, statistic, df, p
distribution.tsv: contrast, n, median, skewness, classification
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Scale/offset, replicate aggregation, donor blocking, per-feature versus pooled ANOVA estimand, fold-change denominator, skewness threshold and repeated-feature dependence.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Native specified model plus independent paired contrasts, medians and moment calculations; reject PBMC inclusion or a pooled cell mean substituted for donor measurements.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need independent sorted-cell miRNA observations; source global ANOVA unit is ambiguous and must be authored before implementation.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: Qualitative distribution shape requires a numeric definition; gene/miRNA rows do not substitute for independent donors.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: What tumor-associated abundance effect is supported for prespecified proteins under a complete observed proteomics comparison?

designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Raw/log assay scale, normalization, peptide-to-protein aggregation if present, pairing, missingness/imputation, native differential model, multiplicity and significant-figure rounding.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Native proteomics model and independent baseline/fold/log arithmetic; reject ratio-of-means versus mean-of-ratios substitution and adjusted p from a one-protein universe.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need independent measured paired or explicitly unpaired proteomics and a valid missingness protocol; full tested-protein output required.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: Named ENO1 endpoint can be retained only if independently measured; otherwise an explicitly different target is a workflow adaptation.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which independently observed patients support joint survival, expression and methylation analysis after assay and identity checks?

rna_distribution.tsv: scale, n, skewness, classification
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Assay presence versus per-feature missingness, duplicate aliquots, one sample per patient, nonmissing vital status, raw/log scale and skewness estimator/thresholds.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Independent joins and moment reference; reject a complete-case count based on sample IDs that do not identify the same patients or missing assay encoded zero.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need independently accessible multi-assay clinical data and permitted metadata; no survival fit is implied by this eligibility task.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: How do age and body size associate with an observed binary treatment-response category under separate and combined logistic models?
designs.input_design: Independent observed patient-level response, age, BMI and documented sex/gender variable, with treatment and eligibility provenance.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: patients.tsv: id, response, age, bmi, category, inclusion
models.tsv: model, term, beta, se, p, log_likelihood, aic, converged
predictions.tsv: model, age, other_covariates, probability
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Exact response event definition, observed sex versus gender label, complete-case rows shared or model-specific, MLE convergence/separation, predictor reference values, Wald versus likelihood-ratio p-values and AIC parameter count.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Native logistic fits and independent design/log-likelihood/sigmoid/AIC arithmetic; reject reversed event labels, an incorrect coefficient or a prediction outside the declared covariate specification.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need independent cohort with sufficient response events and overlap at queried age; undefined separated fits need deterministic status.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: Source alternates partial response and remission; resolve the event definition before mapping. Cross-sectional associations do not establish treatment efficacy.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: How do observed extreme age-associated methylation sites distribute across chromosomes after unique-site and callable-space accounting?
designs.input_design: Independent observed methylation BED/cytosine reports with coverage, age-association output or raw age-linked samples, and reference chromosome sizes/callable intervals.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: sites.bed: chrom, start, end, site_id
site_status.tsv: site, sample, methylated, total, fraction, age_associated, extreme
chromosomes.tsv: chrom, callable_bp, reference_bp, unique_sites, density
tests.tsv: model, expected_basis, chi2, df, p
summary.tsv: species, filtered_sites, density_estimator
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Coordinate system, methylation fraction versus percentage, coverage filter, strict 0.1/0.9 thresholds, across-sample union, age-association eligibility, chromosome exclusions, mean chromosome density versus genome-weighted density, length/callable expected counts.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Native interval operations plus independent unique-site counts, densities and chi-square arithmetic; reject double-counted sites, percentage/fraction confusion or equal-count null labeled uniform per-base distribution.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need independent age-linked methylation observations and matched genome build/callability; two species optional only if both cohorts are valid.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: Source uniform-genome wording is ambiguous between equal chromosome counts and equal density; freeze the null. Age-related labels require actual age evidence, not invented annotation.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which perturbation gene/pathway conclusions change under a prespecified replicate-quality sensitivity analysis?
designs.input_design: Independent replicated observed perturbation/control raw counts with documented QC/batch variables and fixed mouse or species-matched pathway annotations.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: samples.tsv: sample, condition, qc_reason, primary_inclusion, sensitivity_inclusion
genes.tsv: analysis, gene, effect, shrunk_effect, base_mean, p, q
pathways.tsv: analysis, library, term, overlap, p, q, rank
sensitivity.tsv: endpoint, primary_value, sensitivity_value, direction
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: QC exclusion declared before differential results, exact model/shrinkage, raw versus adjusted p masks, contrast direction, annotation versions, top 20 tie rules and case-insensitive keyword definition.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Native fits/enrichment with independent inclusion, top-list and fraction checks; reject exclusion chosen from effect significance, wrong number of tested pathways or reversal of reported sensitivity direction. Only recorded inclusion rules are verifiable.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need independent study with documented QC issue and enough remaining biological replicates; arbitrary dropping of replicate 3 is not a realistic QC policy.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: Source fixed exclusion is adapted to evidence-backed QC. Keep planned sensitivity distinct from choosing the analysis yielding more discoveries.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which observed single-copy orthologs remain across proteomes, and how much alignment material survives an explicit alignment/trimming workflow?
designs.input_design: Four independent observed proteome FASTA releases with species manifests and a pinned BUSCO lineage; retain original sequence identifiers.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: busco.tsv: species, orthogroup, status, sequence_id
shared.tsv: orthogroup, species, sequence_id, amino_acids
alignments/: orthogroup aligned FASTA
trimmed/: orthogroup trimmed FASTA
qc.tsv: orthogroup, pre_columns, post_columns, removed_fraction, gaps, aligned_positions
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: BUSCO mode/lineage/version, complete-single-copy policy across all species, isoform duplication, MAFFT --auto version/thread settings, ClipKIT mode, total gap fraction weighting and reduction ties.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Run actual BUSCO/MAFFT/ClipKIT and independently count membership, residues, positions and retained columns; reject duplicated BUSCO matches or average-of-percentages substituted for global fraction.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Complete proteome BUSCO may exceed 30 minutes; measure it. Precomputed discovery outputs would cover downstream accounting only and cannot claim native discovery coverage for that task.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: Source species/data unknown from questions alone; orthology and input-size suitability remain open. Do not duplicate tiny proteomes to simulate coverage.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: Which pathway responses persist across independently observed perturbation-screen rounds and biological replicates?
designs.input_design: Independent observed guide counts for control and repeated screen conditions, replicate/sample metadata and frozen guide-to-gene/pathway mapping.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: guides.tsv: guide, gene, sample, count, qc
genes.tsv: condition, replicate, gene, mageck_score, p, q
replicate_pairs.tsv: condition, pair, n_genes, spearman_r
pathways.tsv: condition, replicate, term, overlap, p, q
persistence.tsv: term, eligible_rounds, significant_rounds
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: MAGeCK normalization and control selection, selection direction, gene-hit rule, replicate-level versus aggregated tests, pathway universe and immune relevance definition, complete tested-gene correlations and across-round multiplicity.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Native MAGeCK/enrichment oracle plus independent rank correlations, intersections and denominators; reject selected-hits-only correlations or a missing nonsignificant round.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need independent observed repeated screens with adequate guides, counts and replicated rounds; package runtime to be measured.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: Minimum p across replicates is a selection statistic, not automatically calibrated evidence. Retain all replicate tests and label that source summary explicitly; freeze multiplicity for authored conclusions.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: How do read-backed mutation spectra differ between two independently observed bacterial isolates under a common calling and callable-space protocol?
designs.input_design: Observed paired FASTQ for two isolates, matching reference FASTA/GFF3, sample manifest and frozen adapter FASTA, all independent of SRR35233585 and its comparison study.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: read_qc.tsv: sample, input_pairs, surviving_pairs, singletons, dropped_pairs, dropped_reads
alignments.bam: reads, read_groups, indexed
depth.tsv: sample, reference, eligible_bases, depth_sum, mean_depth
variants.vcf: sample, normalized calls, filters
spectra.tsv: sample, snvs, insertions, deletions, transitions, transversions, ratio
comparison.tsv: metric, sample_a, sample_b, callable_adjusted_difference
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: Trimmomatic parameters and pair/read counting, BWA-MEM reference/readgroups, duplicate/secondary/mapQ policy, samtools depth include-zero denominator, bacterial ploidy in GATK, call filters, normalized SNV/indel classification and Ts/Tv zero handling.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Actual read QC/alignment/calling oracle plus independent FASTQ counts, reference-depth arithmetic, allele normalization and mutation classes; reject diploid bacterial genotypes if haploid specified, missing zero-depth bases or multibase variants counted as SNVs.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need independent observed isolate pair with manageable read depth and licensed reference; GATK environment and complete run under 30 minutes remain unverified.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: True SNP means retained calls under this contract unless independent truth exists. Static mutation counts do not establish mutation accumulation rate, mechanism or resistance causality; final comparison is a structured evidence-bound output.

designs.scientific_question_on_independent_obser: How do independently observed RNA modification changes co-occur with expression changes after assay-specific normalization and gene mapping?
designs.input_design: Independent observed MeRIP/input and RNA expression count evidence with condition, biological replicates, peak-to-gene annotations and frozen result thresholds.
proposed_artifacts_and_key_columns: assays.tsv: sample, condition, assay, replicate, normalization
modification.tsv: gene, effect, p, q, class, eligible
expression.tsv: gene, effect, p, q, class, eligible
contingency.tsv: modification_class, expression_class, count
summary.tsv: eligible_genes, hyper_up, hyper_total, hypo_total, chi2, df, p
designs.method_and_decision_parameters_to_freeze: MeRIP enrichment relative to input, peak aggregation and multimapping, gene universe across assays, hyper/hypo and up/down thresholds, treatment of unchanged/unmeasured genes, chi-square correction and sparse cells.
designs.deterministic_verifier_design_and_negati: Native assay references plus independent gene joins, full contingency, marginal denominators and ratio arithmetic; reject RNA abundance substituted for modification effect or unmapped features counted as unchanged.
designs.unresolved_data_and_runtime_requirements: Need independently observed paired modification/input and expression assays; otherwise source-derived effect tables cover joint analysis only, not upstream differential modification.
designs.endpoint_adaptation_limits: m6A is RNA modification and must not be treated as genomic CpG methylation. Association between assay classes does not establish regulation.

ortholog_signal_contract.execution_protocol: Harbor only; no notebook protocol. This specification creates no runnable task or coverage credit.

wheel_source_verification.result: All 11 reviewed files match both their pinned Git tree blobs and downloaded PhyKIT 2.7.0 wheel members. This is source identity evidence, not new native execution.

data.interpretation: A/B replace the source animal/fungal groups with two explicitly named animal clades; taxonomic study equivalence is not claimed. Original orthogroups are the locus units. Candidate rights and benchmark lineage are not cleared.
data.paired_units: One retained alignment/tree per original orthogroup and clade. Both clades share each locus; retain all eligibility and exclusion rows.
data.named_loci: Order original orthogroup IDs lexically before computing outcomes. Positions 1, 2, 3 and 4 define named_locus_dvmc, named_locus_lb, named_locus_distance and named_locus_rate, respectively. Record the resolved IDs in the public manifest.
data.five_tree_panel: The five lexically first original orthogroup IDs in clade A, selected before outcomes. This is the exact denominator for the five-tree endpoint, not all 30 loci or all 60 trees.

tree_preparation.rooting: Prune using DendroPy 5.0.8, preserve distances while suppressing unifurcations, then midpoint-root with the audited DendroPy path. Midpoint is a geometric convention, not an inferred biological ancestor. Serialize the root edge as zero.
tree_preparation.branch_rules: Retain input precision and original identifiers; reject negative/nonfinite lengths, duplicate tips or mismatched alignment/tree taxon sets. An omitted root length becomes zero; missing non-root lengths are invalid. No outcome-based locus dropping.
checks: Every original retained pairwise distance equals its pruned and rooted distance within the numerical contract.
Root-to-tip depth along a diameter equals half the original diameter; all tips and alignment rows have exact matching identities.

alignment_rules.alphabet: Uppercase observed amino-acid alignments. Preserve native gaps and masked symbols; reject unknown non-ASCII symbols. Flag observed B/Z/J/U/O rather than silently converting them.
alignment_rules.asparagine: N is a protein residue, not missing DNA. Every native calculation must use protein mode.
alignment_rules.gap_percent: 100 * literal hyphen cells / (n_taxa * alignment_columns). Report the wider native missing-symbol fraction separately. The source question does not define gap-versus-missing convention; this is an explicit authored choice.
alignment_rules.columns: Keep the original aligned columns after clade subsetting, including all-gap columns. Do not silently retrim separately per clade.
alignment_rules.source_adaptation: Native PhyKIT counts nonexcluded ambiguity letters as states. Report both native results and a canonical-20-amino-acid sensitivity result when B/Z/J/U/O occur; do not label the two as identical estimands.

metrics.tree_length: Sum every branch length on the processed tree, including a root edge fixed to zero.
metrics.treeness: Sum nonterminal branch lengths / total tree length on the same processed tree; undefined when total length is zero.
metrics.evolutionary_rate: Total tree length / number of terminal taxa. This is a branch-length summary, not a time-calibrated evolutionary rate.
metrics.dvmc: Sample SD (ddof=1) of terminal root-to-tip distances; no division by the mean. Across-locus SD of these DVMC values is a separate aggregation.
metrics.patristic: One row for each unordered distinct-tip pair. Locus mean/median use all n*(n-1)/2 pairs, with no self-distances or reciprocal duplicates.
metrics.lb_native: Use the pinned native long-branch implementation and preserve its historical taxon-name denominator. For candidate multi-character IDs without single-character tip collisions, each tip mean includes its zero self-distance and divides by n. Score is 100*(tip_mean/global_unordered_pair_mean - 1). Audit names before using this simplification.
metrics.lb_self_excluded: Separately report 100*(sum of distances to other tips/(n-1)/global_unordered_pair_mean - 1). Do not silently substitute it for native LB. Across-tip mean is zero up to numerical precision; native mean is -100/n under the stated identifier condition.
metrics.informative: A column is informative when at least two nonexcluded states each occur at least twice. Count all columns in the denominator; informative_percent=100*informative_count/alignment_columns.
metrics.rcv: For sequence i and each nonexcluded observed symbol a, count c_ia; let cbar_a be the mean count over n sequences and L_i the nonexcluded length. Native RCV is sum_i(sum_a(abs(c_ia-cbar_a))/(n*L_i)); a zero-L_i sequence contributes zero. This is not composition frequencies normalized to a common aligned length.
metrics.saturation: Use native gap-excluded pair distances: y is mismatch count divided by positions where both sequences lack native missing symbols; x is patristic distance. Fit through the origin with slope=sum(x*y)/sum(x*x) over finite pairs. Retain slope and abs(1-slope); the authored saturation endpoint uses abs(1-slope). It is not a free-intercept regression or Pearson correlation.
metrics.treeness_over_rcv: Divide unrounded treeness by unrounded RCV for each matched alignment/tree, then summarize ratios. Undefined when RCV is zero; never replace it with an infinite or zero score.

aggregation_rules.input_precision: Authored endpoints use unrounded native API values or independently audited full-precision formulas, with at least 12 significant digits retained. Native CLI outputs are additional evidence at their documented display precision. Source CLI rounding may induce different ties; this is an explicit precision adaptation, not a claim of exact source answers.
aggregation_rules.sd_variance: Across-locus SD and variance use ddof=1. n<2 gives insufficient_observations. Source wording does not resolve ddof; the authored task states this choice.
aggregation_rules.quantiles: Median and 75th percentile use NumPy 2.2.6 method=linear. Thresholds use unrounded values and the written strict > or < comparison.
aggregation_rules.mann_whitney: SciPy 1.15.3 mannwhitneyu(A,B,alternative=two-sided,method=asymptotic,use_continuity=True). Return U for A. Independently reconstruct U using average pooled ranks; use the native tie-corrected p-value and report n_A, n_B and tie groups.
aggregation_rules.interpretation: Matched clade loci are dependent; Mann-Whitney is retained only as a descriptive source-requested calculation. Its p-value must not be presented as valid independent-samples evidence about clade differences. Complete paired differences are a separate required artifact.
aggregation_rules.directions: Differences and fold ratios mean B-A and B/A unless the endpoint explicitly uses abs. A ratio of medians and the median of paired ratios remain different columns.
aggregation_rules.weighting: Compute tip/pair summaries within each locus first, then use equally weighted loci. Do not pool tips/pairs across loci. Retain every denominator and eligible-locus identity.
aggregation_rules.undefined: Keep rows with reason codes: zero_denominator, empty_selection, insufficient_observations or no_comparable_sites. Numeric value is null, not NaN/Inf or an invented zero. Summaries report total, eligible and excluded counts. Require a nonempty eligible set for a numerical endpoint.
aggregation_rules.saturation_degeneracy: Zero comparable sites makes a pair unavailable. If no finite pairs remain or sum(x*x)=0, the scientific slope is undefined. Preserve the native zero-slope fallback only in an audit field, not as evidence of saturation.
aggregation_rules.rounding: Only explicitly rounded endpoint displays use decimal ROUND_HALF_EVEN (three decimals for bix-35-q4 and integer for bix-60-q1). Retain the unrounded calculation in a separate column.

artifacts.native_audit.json: Exact commands/API entry points, package versions, source hashes and native output, including display precision and any undefined/native discrepancy.

acceptance.identity: All manifest loci, tips, unordered pairs and 47 endpoint rows must be present exactly once under their full key. Exact integer counts, IDs, order conventions and reason codes. Extra or missing rows fail.
acceptance.numeric: For finite full-precision fields, proposed abs error <=1e-8 + 1e-6*abs(reference); exact rounded integer/decimal endpoints. Reconfirm these bounds against the pinned independent computations before task release; do not loosen them in response to a solver. Never use tolerance to change threshold membership.
independent_checks: Reconstruct branch/path sums with a second parser and compare all pairs.
Count informative sites, symbol counts and eligible pair positions independently from FASTA.
Rebuild every endpoint from the complete submitted primitive tables, then compare those tables with private input-derived reference values. Self-consistency alone is insufficient.
Independently check MWU rank sums, paired versus marginal reductions, strict thresholds, all denominators and zero/empty statuses.
incorrect_output_checks: Pool pair distances across loci instead of averaging locus means.
Use mean of ratios in place of ratio of medians or median of ratios.
Count protein N as missing or replace genuine gaps with inserted gaps.
Use native LB where self-excluded LB is requested, or reverse them.
Regress saturation with a free intercept or substitute slope for abs(1-slope).
Drop an undefined or low-signal locus, reverse U_A/U_B, or invent a zero maximum for an empty >70% gap subset.
Use 30 trees instead of the declared five-tree panel.

readiness.planning_decisions_resolved: Exact metric semantics and 47 endpoint aggregation expressions are specified. Selection rules do not depend on metric outcomes.
still_required: Clear exact candidate file rights and independence from benchmark study lineage.
Verify actual native alignment/saturation results on all retained alignments, including missing-symbol cases; source/wheel file identity is now confirmed.
Confirm the complete reference and verifier in Harbor with incorrect-output tests and a measured <=30-minute solve.
Resolve whether naturally observed >70% literal-gap alignments exist for bix-25-q4. An empty result is valid authored reporting but provides no nonempty-maximum endpoint coverage.
